Metric definitions

The metrics are read from each case's invented response, laid out as p123api-screen-backtest version 1: none comes from Portfolio123. Each is defined as that layout defines it. The benchmark's metrics are defined as the strategy's.

MetricIdentifierDefinition
Coverage startcoverage_startThe first transaction date in the response's periods.
Coverage endcoverage_endThe end of the response's last period.
Coverage periodscoverage_periodsThe number of rebalance periods.

Annualized returnannualized_returnCompound annual growth rate over the calendar days from the first to the last date of the daily series, with 365.25-day years.
Maximum drawdownmax_drawdownThe largest peak-to-trough decline in the daily series, as a negative number.

CorrelationcorrelationCorrelation with the benchmark.
R squaredr_squaredThe square of the correlation.
BetabetaBeta against the benchmark.
AlphaalphaAlpha against the benchmark, as the response layout defines it. Its unit is inferred from the value's magnitude, and its method isn't documented.
Risk samplesrisk_samplesThe number of returns behind the risk statistics.

6. Robustness and concentration

Not assessed. The cases are variants of one baseline, predefined in the plan before any request was sent, but Trial Folio doesn't assess robustness or the concentration of contributions from them. A variant whose outcome is used to choose a candidate is part of the search, not independent evidence for that candidate.

7. Statistical methods and uncertainty

Statistical validation: Not assessed. No statistical method was applied, so the report states no uncertainty, multiple-testing adjustment, or power. Summary statistics alone don't support intervals, a return series, or a drawdown history, so none is shown or reconstructed.

The current plan has 3 cases, and revisions retired 0. Attempts made: 3, with 0 repeats among them. These counts are the experiment's research history, not a multiple-testing family: an attempt or a repeat is a provider operation, not a hypothesis, and a predefined variant isn't one either, unless its outcome informs a selection.

8. Development, selection, holdout, and forward evidence

Unavailable: each case is a synthetic example over the same requested dates. The experiment has no separate development, selection, holdout, or forward period.

Synthetic: invented values, neither backtested nor actual results.

9. Feasibility, capacity, and missing execution evidence

Trading readiness: Not assessed. Feasibility and capacity aren't assessed.

Execution evidence this experiment doesn't have:

  • Actual trades: none.
  • Commission: Not modeled by this provider path: the API documents no commission parameter, and slippage is its only trading-cost input.
  • Parameters not sent, whose defaults aren't documented: max_pos_pct, rank_tolerance, carry_cost, long_weight, short_weight.
  • Turnover, positions, and per-period returns: preserved in the saved responses, but not interpreted.

10. Conclusion, limitations, and artifacts

Permitted conclusion

Every planned case succeeded: its invented response was saved and normalized. That's a statement about execution, not about any strategy. No case is ranked, selected, or called best. Statistical validation and trading readiness are not assessed, so this report permits no conclusion about whether any case's strategy is useful, or whether its results could be achieved.

Limitations

  • Synthetic: invented values, neither backtested nor actual results.
  • Reproducibility is incomplete: universe names an object in the Portfolio123 account whose definition wasn't captured. If it changes, the same configuration can give different results.
  • The prior research is declared complete, and Trial Folio can't verify the declaration.
  • Inferred defaults, not reported by Portfolio123: data_vendor, risk_stats_period.
  • Only summary statistics are reported: no return series, drawdown history, or interval is shown.
  • This is session 2's report. Each later run of the experiment that reaches its end writes its own report and manifest, which supersede this one, and replaces no file.
